title: Wso2am: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection') vulnerability in Apache…
description: A high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-70410) affects the wso2am package due to unsafe reflection in Apache Calcite Avatica. This vulnerability involves the use of externally-controlled input to select classes or code, which can lead to significant confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts. Fixed versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 address this issue.
